About the shop

For DIY wrappers, designers and installers.

The Satin Shop is the self-serve side of our studio. Vehicle wrap designs are ready-made artwork you can browse by style, colour and industry, licensed per vehicle. Vehicle templates are accurate 1:1 vector outlines for designers at $25 CAD each, and design services start with a deposit that is credited to production when you go ahead.

Vehicle wrap prints is a print-only service for installers and DIY wrappers: we print your file on 3M IJ180 cast film with matching laminate, or cut it as vinyl lettering, ready for pickup or shipping. Materials and tools covers wrap films, squeegees and installation essentials.

Not sure what you need? We check every file before it is printed and can recommend the right film, template or design package for your project.

Not sure where to start?

Tell us what you’re working on and we’ll point you to the right design, template or service.
